findings.evidence: Lines 104–106 explicitly justify exposure by making `PunctureFilling` lemmas apply; those characteristic lemmas exist at Instances/PunctureFilling.lean:200–225, but this file exports only the inclusion evaluation.
findings.fix: Remove `@[expose]` and export characteristic lemmas for the filled-cover charts, including center source, target, evaluations, and inverse evaluations.
findings.issue: Exposing `FilledCover.chartedSpace` makes consumers depend on its implementation to access the inherited chart API.

findings.evidence: The theorem at lines 115–116 has no annotation; both underlying evaluation lemmas are `@[simp]` in Instances/PunctureFilling.lean:189–191 and Instances/Comap.lean:80–83.
findings.fix: Annotate this theorem with `@[simp]` so chart evaluations normalize through the public API.
findings.issue: `chartAt_incl_apply_incl` lacks `@[simp]` despite reducing chart evaluation to its canonical value `p y`.

summary: The charted-space body is exposed to compensate for missing characteristic lemmas. Its specialized chart evaluation also lacks the normal-form simp annotation.
